summary: Show the birds heard by BirdNET-Go on your Mac or Linux computer.
page_description: See the birds BirdNET-Go hears on your computer, drawn as Fugleramme's labelled plates and sent to your Kobo. The last collage stays on screen offline.
release_notes: The bar now says Birds, and an empty frame lists the exact commands to run on your computer.

steps.text: Run BirdNET-Go and Fugleramme on a Mac or Linux computer with a microphone. See apps/birds/README.md.
Once per reader: with it plugged in over USB, run kobo setup --enable-ssh. Then save it so the commands below find it on Wi-Fi without an address.
Start mirroring what BirdNET-Go hears to the reader.
